cart_excl_tax_delivery = cart_res.get('base_cost',0.0) + cart_res.get('gift_wrap_fee',0.0) - cart_res.get('discount',0.0)
wishlist_excl = sum(item.get('price',0.0)*item.get('quantity',0.0) for item in wish_res)
combined = cart_excl_tax_delivery + wishlist_excl
print('cart_excl_tax_delivery', cart_excl_tax_delivery)
print('wishlist_excl_tax_delivery', wishlist_excl)
print('combined', combined)
